subject: english
question: **Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. Hopefully, the match will be won by our team. **

options.text: Hopefully, our team will have win the match.
Hopefully, our team will win the match.
Hopefully, our team will be winning the match.
Hopefully, our team will be win the match.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Hopefully, our team will win the match.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Identify the subject (**doer **of the action), the verb, and the object (**receiver **of the action) in the passive sentence.
 
• In this case, the subject "**our team**" should become the doer of the action.
 
• Since the original sentence uses "**will be won**" in the future tense, you can use the future tense in the active voice: "Hopefully, our team will..."
 
• The main action in this sentence is "**win**," so it should be included: "Hopefully, our team will win..."
 
• In this case, there's no need for an object at the end of the sentence because it's already clear what our team is winning.
 
• Therefore, the correct active voice sentence would be "Our team will win the match, hopefully."

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer
